note: Large Corps of Engineers campground on Mark Twain Lake's north shore: five wooded loops on points between coves, with a swim beach, boat ramp and fish cleaning station. Perimeter sites see the lake through the trees. --Claude
summary: rec.gov catalog/calendar/rates read: 190 back-in RV sites (161x50A, 29x30A, 65 w/s), $24/$30; season Apr 2-Nov 21; lakeview confirmed (filtered views); pin is the facility point 2.9 km from the loops; phone added.
flags: PIN (move): the stored 39.5392,-91.7331 is recreation.gov's facility point, in unbroken forest 2.9 km WNW of the camping loops (the group camp is about 900 m SSW of it). The 190 RV sites are in five loops (SRID, NHAW, FLOO, EPOI and the hike-in ICRE) between 39.5138 and 39.5299 N. Their centroid, 39.52233,-91.70792, falls in the woods between the loops. Proposed pin: 39.52016,-91.71126, which is NHAW site 087, the RV site nearest that centroid, on the loop road.

WATERFRONT agrees: lakeview stands. Each loop is on a wooded point, and the perimeter sites sit about 20-55 m above the shoreline: FLOO 107/108 about 20-30 m, NHAW 79A/79B/80 about 30 m, SRID 31/32 and 47-49 about 40-55 m, EPOI 158-160 about 70 m. The ground between them and the water is continuous oak canopy on a slope, with no open apron, so the sites aren't on-water. The recreation.gov site photos for NHAW 077 and 080 and FLOO 110 show the lake through the trees. Under the filtered-view rule (curation doc, AWH 2026-11-01), that earns lakeview.

SEASON: written from the calendar as 04-02 to 11-21 (the 2027 dates). Both years follow the same pattern: the first Friday of April to the Sunday before Thanksgiving. From April to early May only about 85 sites are open.
